notes: Exalted: The Sidereals reviewed cover-to-cover for Chapters One through Six, plus the cross-splat supplements Savant and Sorcerer, Book of Three Circles, Exalted Storyteller's Companion, and Savage Seas fully triaged for Sidereal scope. 567 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/sidereal/inventory/. Core book (252 rows): the character-creation overview (including the Ronin variant), the five Auspicious-Ability groups and Celestial Hierarchy minimums, the universal Anima Effect, all five Castes, the Arcane Fate signature trait mechanic and its Sidereal Anima Banner visibility/Paradox table, the Craft (Fate) Ability specialty, the altered/new Backgrounds, Chapter Five's general Charm framework, all 25 of Chapter Five's Caste-and-Ability Charm trees in full across all five Castes (152 Charms total), all three of the book's named secret Martial Arts styles (Charcoal March of Spiders, Prismatic Arrangement of Creation, Citrine Poxes of Contagion), the full Sidereal Astrology system (rules framework, Resplendent Destinies, and the complete named-College catalog closing Chapter Six: the Houses of Journeys/Leisure/War/Secrets/Endings and the five Greater Signs), and cross-referenced sorcery spells/a Specialized Prayer. Merits/Flaws confirmed genuinely absent from this book (re-verified via the full alphabetical index). Chapter Seven onward (Storytelling/setting material) is out of scope. Savant and Sorcerer + Book of Three Circles (220 more rows): the complete Chapter Five Terrestrial/Celestial Circle spell catalog (84 selectable spells), a 102-entry Hearthstone catalog (15 from Savant and Sorcerer plus 87 from Book of Three Circles' Chapter Six 'long roll,' since Savant and Sorcerer does not reprint it), a 13-row Artifice and Enchantment catalog (rules framework rows, two named Merits, a Magical Materials reference, and 5 selectable Sample Artifacts), a 13-row Warstriders appendix (rules framework, all five warstrider design classes as selectable equipment, weapon-catalog references, and the Proteus Gauntlet artifact), and an 8-row skim of Chapter One (Magical Theory) and Chapter Four (Practical Summonings) yielding only gm-only/reference-only content. A further pass then read the entire Sidereal portion of the Exalted Storyteller's Companion's Chapter Two (printed pp. 34-41/PDF 35-42): almost entirely narrative, with its only mechanical content (four 'Sample Charms': Force Decision, Absence, Wise Choice, Prior Warning) confirmed to be exact verbatim reprints of Charms already inventoried from Chapter Five, so no new rows were added at the time; this source book was added to the manifest purely for the citation trail. A skim of Chapter One and Chapter Three of the same book found only Dragon-Blooded and Spirit/NPC material, no Sidereal or Lunar player-facing exceptions. A fifteenth pass added 15 more rows (487 total): six rows derived from Lunar's already-verified transcription of the Exalted Storyteller's Companion's universal Chapter Four artifact catalog ('Further Wonders' -- Ghost Cestus, Sling Bow of Ice, The Golden Viper, Land Ship, Singing Staff, Eye of Autochthon), and eight named-artifact rows plus one reference-only summary table freshly transcribed from a fifth source book, Exalted: Savage Seas (Cargo Preservation Spindles, Armor of Aquatic Puissance, Steelsilk Sails, Storm Sapphire, Cord of Winds, Wavecleaver Daiklaive, Light Implosion Bow, Lightning Ballista, and the Artifact Ship Weapons summary table), covering the entire naval 'Artifacts of the Waves' catalog with no splat restriction. A sixteenth pass then filled the previously-confirmed Merits/Flaws gap: 80 of the Exalted Players Guide's 88 universal `pg-merit-*`/`pg-flaw-*` rows (Chapter One, 'Merits and Flaws') were derived from Lunar's already-verified transcription of that chapter, using this project's shared `pg-*` id scheme (as already done for Abyssal, Alchemical, and Fair Folk); 8 rows were excluded as inapplicable to Sidereal (Chimera, Limited Forms, Death Taint, Legendary Breeding, Taint's Warning, Innocuous, Eternal Vow, Past Lives), 57 transferred verbatim, and 23 carry a Sidereal-specific reinterpretation (most notably Priest, Destiny, Lucky, Prescient Dreamer, Alternative Divination, Greater Curse, and Dark Fate, the last of which is normally exempt for ordinary Sidereals serving the Bureau of Destiny), bringing the inventory to its current 567 rows. Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. Locked pending schema/rules/creator/editor implementation and passing tests across all five planned families.
